name: Job Seeker residence permit (post-study, § 20 AufenthG)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires having completed a degree at a German university or a recognised vocational training (Ausbildung) program in Germany.
This requires proof of funds of €13,092/year (€1,091/month, 2026 figure).
requirements.fix_path: Build the required savings or secure a formal funding declaration.

evidence_required.document: German university degree certificate or vocational training completion certificate
Proof of funds for the search period

sources.title: Bundesagentur für Arbeit - funds requirement (same €1,091/month figure as Chancenkarte)

notes: This is the POST-STUDY / POST-AUSBILDUNG variant of § 20 specifically — distinct from the abroad job-seeker route, which the Chancenkarte has largely superseded since 2024. Unrestricted work rights during the search period (a real difference from the Chancenkarte's capped 20 hours/week) — graduates can take any job while searching, not just trial/side work, because they've already demonstrated integration through their German qualification. This is the direct downstream link from both de_student and de_ausbildung, closing the Journey chain that mirrors the UK's Student→Graduate structure. Non-renewable and terminal if no job is found — must switch to a work permit before expiry or leave Germany, structurally similar to the UK's Graduate visa.
